commands.command: set -eu; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; test -n "$serial"; echo RUN_AS_PWD_BEGIN; adb -s "$serial" shell run-as io.blueeye pwd; echo RUN_AS_PWD_END; echo TOP_LEVEL_BEGIN; adb -s "$serial" shell run-as io.blueeye ls -1; echo TOP_LEVEL_END; echo DATABASES_BEGIN; adb -s "$serial" shell run-as io.blueeye ls -la databases 2>&1 || true; echo DATABASES_END; echo DB_FIND_BEGIN; adb -s "$serial" shell run-as io.blueeye find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'tracker_database*' -print 2>/dev/null || true; echo DB_FIND_END
